{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(data))

# Identify duplicates
duplicate_patients = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(duplicate_patients))

# Show how many times each patient appears
print("Patient ID frequency:")
print(duplicate_patients['patient_id'].value_counts().head())"}
